title: map.odin header claims district-scoped ATTACH draws; growth.odin implements and documents a GLOBAL ring
detail: The shipped interplay documentation contradicts itself. map.odin and the golden demo header state estates never cross district boundaries; the actual ATTACH draw scans ALL pool tiles with no district filter.
recommended_fix: Update core/map.odin:32-36 and demos/dublin_board.dem:5-8 to describe the global street ring (the growth.odin/PR-ratified behavior); delete the district-scoping claim.

title: map_test.odin header claims district-assignment/district-range/district-containment pins that no test asserts
detail: Claimed durable pins are fiction: district assignment, per-district ranges, and district containment are asserted nowhere; the district machinery (candidate_district/district_start/board_district_at) is dead data in shipped code paths.
recommended_fix: Either assert the claimed pins in map_test.odin (district assignment, district_start shape, attach district containment) or drop claims (b)/(d) and the PR's 'pinned by tests' line.

title: map_board_load error paths leak the partially-built board — `return {}` discards allocated buffers
detail: Every mid-parse failure (corrupt asset) leaks attribution, district names, candidates, and loaded rings — unrecoverable by callers. Project rule: dev tracking allocator makes leaks CI failures.
recommended_fix: Return the partial board with the error (`return b, err`) so callers call map_board_destroy, or destroy b before each error return inside map_board_load.

title: Orphan pool accessors map_board_pool_lo/hi (never referenced) with a comment naming a nonexistent proc; ring scan has unused params
detail: Dead accessors whose comment references the nonexistent `map_board_candidate_pool`, plus unused `t`/`alloc` parameters — leftovers of the abandoned district-scoped draw design.
recommended_fix: Delete map_board_pool_lo/hi (and fix the comment), drop the unused `t`/`alloc` params from growth_board_ring_scan.

title: map_ring_clean/map_line_clean silently drop malformed geometry, contradicting map_board_load's documented fail-loud contract
detail: A malformed point inside any terrain/street polygon yields a silently partial board — the exact outcome the loader's contract forbids; inconsistent failure semantics.
recommended_fix: Either propagate a failure from map_ring_clean/map_line_clean (fail loud) or soften the map_board_load doc to state malformed rings are skipped defensively.

title: App comment promises the board is 'freed at exit' and dublin_render_destroy is 'called by view teardown' — neither call exists
detail: Board buffers (~MBs of rings + cell grid) and the View cache leak at exit under the app allocator; the comments promise teardown that never happens.
recommended_fix: Add map_board_destroy/app-view teardown at app exit, or correct both comments to state process-exit ownership.

title: json_get_int re-implements catalog's jint (same package); dublin.odin triplicates the cstring-build loop and builds each label's cstring twice per frame
detail: Three copies of the string→cstring conversion in two packages; per label per frame the district name is copied twice. jcol-style reuse of jint needs one signature choice.
recommended_fix: Reuse core jint (widen its return) in map.odin; make draw_text_font_halo accept a prebuilt cstring (or add a shared cstring helper) and pass dublin_label_cstr's result through.
